usedFor: Timeero tracks time and jobs, and “Job Created” can feed Google Docs through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “Task Created” in Timeero, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each new Timeero task can add its details to a doc tab, so the job write-up keeps up.

watchOut: The action can overwrite a tab’s content, so check that setting before “Job Updated” runs it again.
